headline: Mobileye Shares Hit 52-Week Low at $6.45
summary: Mobileye shares declined significantly, touching a 52-week low at $6.45 amid ongoing market pressures.
why: Mobileye is a prominent developer of advanced driver-assistance systems and autonomous driving technologies.

impacts.name: Mobileye Global Inc.
impacts.why: A plunging share price reflects diminished near-term valuation confidence from equity markets.

why_moved: Persistent selling pressure drove the stock down to new lows, reflecting cautious investor sentiment toward autonomous driving valuations.
